description: This file defines an abstract class SecureConnectionProvider for managing secure JDBC connections with Kerberos authentication, including configuration handling and external dependencies on Java SQL, JAAS, and Spark internal utilities.

classes.name: SecureConnectionProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing secure JDBC connection handling with Kerberos authentication support.

classes.name: SecureConnectionProvider.JDBCConfiguration
classes.description: A class extending JAAS Configuration to provide specific login module entries for Kerberos authentication.

methods.name: canHandle
methods.description: Checks if the driver and options are compatible with this provider based on driver class and keytab/principal presence.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Establishes a JDBC connection after setting up authentication configuration.

methods.name: appEntry
methods.description: Abstract method to return the JAAS application name for the driver and options.

methods.name: setAuthenticationConfig
methods.description: Configures JAAS security settings for the driver using provided options.

methods.name: getAppConfigurationEntry
methods.description: Retrieves JAAS configuration entries for a given application name.
